patch.summary: Close cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Close pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. 14-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.
bullets: Free plan: not confirmed in SG data

blocks.title: Close plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

blocks.heading: Close cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Close against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; 14-day trial documented.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (contact management, lead management, pipeline management) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Growth (list price annual) and Scale (list price annual) per-user pricing is high versus pipeline-only CRMs; calling usage and premium phone lines add cost.. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Inside sales and outbound teams that live on phone/email/SMS requires a paid unlock you will use weekly

Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Growth (list price annual) and Scale (list price annual) per-user pricing is high versus pipeline-only CRMs; calling usage and premium phone lines add cost.
Side-by-side cost with Pipedrive on the same seat count

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Growth (list price annual) and Scale (list price annual) per-user pricing is high versus pipeline-only CRMs; calling usage and premium phone lines add cost.

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Advanced Chloe automation/workflows and predictive dialing depth are concentrated on Growth and Scale.

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Calling is usage-based; AI credits are pooled monthly with plan caps and no rollover.

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Growth/Scale seat pricing is expensive versus pipeline-first CRMs

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Calling usage and premium phone add-ons increase total cost of ownership

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Close on identical constraints.

blocks.title: Model crm spend with Close in mind
blocks.body: Use researched plan structure for Close alongside category cost modelling.
